This section (labelled "Section 1.") is part of EO 13210, the order that established the President's Commission to Strengthen Social Security. Section 3 of EO 13316 of September 17, 2003 (68 FR 55255, published September 23, 2003)  revokes the order by number and lists it among orders that established committees which the revoking order describes as terminated or with completed work; the revoking text reads "(e) Executive Order 13210, establishing the President ’s Commission to 
Strengthen Social Security;" Section 6 of EO 13316 makes that order effective September 30, 2003, so the revocation took effect on that date. The clause therefore ended on 2003-09-30. Section 5(b) of the order called for a final report during the fall of 2001, which is a deadline and not an end.

research_rationale:
EO 13210 established the President's Commission to Strengthen Social Security and contains no provision other than those of a commission order (membership, mission, administration, reports, termination). Its termination clause reads "The Commission shall terminate 30 days after submitting
its final report." That clause is triggered by the date of a report and is not an end under owner ruling 2026-10-21-report-deadline; the report date is not held in any source in the repository, so it is disclosed here and not recorded as an end. Section 3 of EO 13316 of September 17, 2003 (68 FR 55255, published September 23, 2003)  revokes the order by number with the words "(e) Executive Order 13210, establishing the President ’s Commission to 
Strengthen Social Security;" and the first dated end held is 2003-09-30.

savings.reason: Section 3 of EO 13316 of September 17, 2003 (68 FR 55255, published September 23, 2003) revokes EO 13210 by number and contains no saving provision for it. The order created an advisory commission and directed support and reports for it; no continuing independent command or accrued obligation is shown in the held texts.
